conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. Expect lower potential gains but also significantly reduced risk and drawdown. A larger cash buffer provides safety.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% per month by blending broad index exposure with quality tech and some inverse positions. Leverage is reduced, and concentration is managed. Expect moderate growth with controlled risk.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month by shifting to income-generating ETFs like QQQI. Leverage and high-beta single names are eliminated. Expect stable monthly distributions, but NAV can still decline in market downturns. This is for cash-like income, not capital appreciation.
